blocks.source: ペルソナ4
blocks.translation: Persona 4

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: 青春要素が豊富な学園物。キャラクターは男女共に立っていて、通常の何気ないイベントにもユーモアがあって笑える。ダークな雰囲気だったペルソナ３と比較すると、かなりノリが明るくなっている。本筋はミステリー風味で先が気になる作り。各キャラクターと友好度を高めるためのサブイベント（コミュ）も豊富。
blocks.translation: A school story rich in elements of youth. Both the male and female characters are well-developed, and even ordinary, everyday events are humorous and amusing. Compared to the dark atmosphere of Persona 3, this game has a much brighter tone. The main story has a mystery flavor that keeps you wondering what will happen next. There are also plenty of side events (Social Links) for deepening your relationships with each character.

blocks.source: 本作には、バッドエンド、ノーマルエンド、真エンドの３つがある。全ての謎の解消にはノーマルエンドの条件を満たした上で、隠しダンジョンをクリアし、真エンドを見る必要がある。ただ、ノーマルエンドと真エンドの差があまりないため、真エンドはノーマルエンドと比較して、感動が薄れてしまった。
blocks.translation: This game has three endings: a bad ending, a normal ending, and a true ending. To resolve all the mysteries, you must meet the requirements for the normal ending, clear the hidden dungeon, and see the true ending. However, because there is not much difference between the normal and true endings, the true ending feels less moving by comparison.

blocks.source: ノーマルと真エンドは１つにまとめた方が内容が引き締まったのでは？ この辺のグダグダがなければ、物語は満点でも良かったのに……。
blocks.translation: Wouldn’t the story have been tighter if the normal and true endings had been combined into one? Without this kind of meandering, the story could have received a perfect score……

blocks.source: ＲＰＧにしては、ダンジョンや戦闘の割合は少なめ。町・学校などで５時間、ダンジョン探索で５時間を繰り返すような感じである。
blocks.translation: For an RPG, dungeons and battles make up a relatively small portion of the game. You spend about five hours in towns and at school, then about five hours exploring dungeons, repeating this cycle.

blocks.source: テキストが豊富でクリアまで８０時間もかかったにも関わらず、クリアまで６０時間程度のペルソナ１，２よりもテンポがずっと良かったと思う。プレイ時間もペルソナ３と同程度だが、こちらの方がテンポが良く密度が濃い。
blocks.translation: Despite the abundance of text and the 80 hours it took to complete, I felt its pacing was much better than Persona 1 and 2, which took around 60 hours to complete. The playtime is about the same as Persona 3, but this game has better pacing and a denser experience.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: ペルソナ３から、大きなシステムの変更は無いが、全体的に３と比べて解消されている部分が多い。同一システムも２作目となって、洗練されてきたということだろう。ただし、メニューの表示に２秒ほどかかるのはペルソナ３と変わらず。ここは直して欲しかった。
blocks.translation: There are no major system changes from Persona 3, but many aspects have been improved overall compared to 3. Perhaps the system has become more refined now that it is being used for the second game. However, the menu still takes about two seconds to appear, just as in Persona 3. I wish this had been fixed.

blocks.source: ３と違って、仲間にコマンドを指示できるようになったし、いちいち仲間に話しかけなくても装備の変更や魔法の使用が出来る。（もっとも、普通のＲＰＧでは当たり前のことだが・・・）
blocks.translation: Unlike in 3, you can now give commands to your party members, and you can change equipment and use magic without having to speak to them individually. (Of course, this is standard in ordinary RPGs……)

blocks.source: ダンジョンからは簡単に脱出できる上に、途中の階からやり直せるので、難しければ、小マメに戻って回復とセーブすればよい。
blocks.translation: You can escape from dungeons easily, and you can restart from floors partway through. So if things get difficult, you can simply return frequently to recover and save.

blocks.source: 戦闘はシンボルエンカウントなので、エンカウントが多すぎて面倒ということもあまりない。そのため、ペルソナ１，２やメガテン３ほどのしんどさは感じない。
blocks.translation: Since battles use symbol encounters, you rarely feel bothered by having too many encounters. As a result, it does not feel as grueling as Persona 1, 2, or Shin Megami Tensei III.

blocks.source: また、ペルソナ３ほど先制攻撃を取れないため、ザコ戦が楽すぎて単調ということもなくなった。主人公が倒れると、即全滅の仕様は健在だが、仲間の友好度が高いとかばってくれたりする。
blocks.translation: Also, because you cannot get preemptive attacks as often as in Persona 3, random battles are no longer so easy that they become monotonous. The rule that the entire party is immediately wiped out if the protagonist falls is still in place, but party members may protect you when their relationship with you is strong.

blocks.source: 序盤の回復魔法（ディア、メディア）の燃費が中盤の回復魔法（ディアラマ、メディラマ）に比べて悪く、序盤が厳しいわりに、中盤以降がだんだん簡単になっていく印象。
blocks.translation: The early-game healing spells (Dia and Media) are less efficient than the mid-game healing spells (Diarama and Mediarama), giving the impression that the early game is difficult while the game gradually becomes easier from the middle onward.

blocks.source: 特に全体回復の消費が低く、それに合わせてボス敵も強力な全体攻撃を多用してくる。
blocks.translation: In particular, the cost of party-wide healing is low, and boss enemies consequently make frequent use of powerful party-wide attacks.

blocks.source: そのため、後半は「敵の全体攻撃」→「味方の全体回復」のワンパターン戦術になりやすい。ちなみに、これはこの作品に限らず、他のペルソナシリーズ・メガテンシリーズなどにも共通する問題点。
blocks.translation: As a result, the latter half tends to devolve into a one-pattern strategy of “the enemy uses a party-wide attack” → “the party uses party-wide healing.” Incidentally, this is a common issue not only in this game, but also in other Persona and Shin Megami Tensei games.

blocks.source: ペルソナ３のラスボスは何度も変化をしながら、様々な攻撃を繰り返してきたのだが、今回のラスボス戦はかなりワンパターンで今ひとつ。
blocks.translation: The final boss in Persona 3 repeatedly changed form while using various attacks, but this final boss battle is quite repetitive and underwhelming.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: グラフィックの質はペルソナ３とあまり変わらず。グラフィックの凄さで押すといったタイプの作品ではないが、相変わらずのセンスが光る。オープニングアニメーションは美麗だが、作中では作画崩壊することも。ダンジョンのバリエーションは増加。後は、キャラクターデザインが好みに合うかといったところ。
blocks.translation: The quality of the graphics is not much different from Persona 3. This is not the kind of game that relies on impressive graphics, but its consistently excellent sense of style shines through. The opening animation is beautiful, though the artwork occasionally breaks down during the game. The variety of dungeons has increased. Ultimately, it comes down to whether the character designs suit your tastes.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 相変わらずボーカル付きの曲が豊富でセンスが光る。戦闘曲や町の曲など明るめの曲が多い。３と比較して最も優れている点はダンジョン曲の良さ。特に後半のダンジョンは美しいものが多い。
blocks.translation: As always, there are plenty of vocal songs, showcasing an excellent sense of style. There are many upbeat tracks, including the battle and town music. The biggest improvement over 3 is the quality of the dungeon music. In particular, many of the latter-half dungeon tracks are beautiful.
